bundleSize.heading: Bundle Size. Optimized.
bundleSize.subheading: Six techniques applied in this app — not just talked about.

one.title: Router Lazy-Loading
one.desc: Every page loads only when navigated to. Zero upfront JavaScript for routes you haven't visited.

two.title: Standalone API
two.desc: No NgModules. Components declare their own imports, making unused code invisible to the bundler.

three.title: CSS Animations Only
three.desc: No @angular/animations package. Native keyframes and IntersectionObserver — same effect, zero cost.

four.title: Pure Functions
four.desc: Stateless utilities live as plain functions, not class methods. The bundler tree-shakes what isn't used.

five.title: Deferrable Views
five.desc: Below-fold sections load on scroll, not on boot. The initial page only pays for what the user sees first.

six.title: Zoneless
six.desc: No zone.js. Change detection runs on signals only — faster, smaller, and easier to reason about.
